notes.title: 🛠️ Early Playtest Update - Fix bugs – July 4, 2025
Early Playtest Update – July 2, 2025
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! We’ve rolled out a new update packed with tuning, enhancements, and fixes based on recent playtest feedback. Here’s what’s new:


Gameplay & Level Design Adjustments
Circle Collapse Rework:

Revamped the first circle collapse challenge for better pacing and clarity. 

Difficulty Tuning: 

Early-game difficulty has been lowered, especially on Easy mode, to ensure a smoother onboarding experience.

 
Balance & Experience Improvements
Skill Buffs:

 Boosted base values of several abilities, with improved critical strike scaling.

Gear Enhancements: Weapon and ring affix values have been strengthened across the board.

Legendary Gear Rework – Breath of the Dying: 

 Effect duration extended.

 Now grants damage reduction and instant healing on activation instead of invulnerability.

 Removed critical strike bonus for better balance.

Loot Magnetism:

Standardized pickup radius for gold and XP orbs to improve flow and consistency. 

Survivability Upgrades:

Multiple new life recovery methods added, and existing healing mechanics enhanced.  


Bug Fixes
Affix Display Issue:

Fixed inconsistencies in item affix value displays. 

Crash Stability:

Addressed several intermittent crashes. 

Note: GPU-related crashes on certain devices are still under investigation.

notes.title: [Patch Notes｜2025/6/18] Bug Fixes & Experience Improvements
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The latest patch released on June 18, 2025, brings several important fixes and optimizations aimed at improving overall gameplay stability and user experience. Please find the details below:

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the Boss would occasionally stop moving during battles, ensuring smoother combat flow.

Corrected display errors in the stat values of Fates with different rarities to ensure accurate information.

Resolved language recognition errors affecting certain regions for better localization support.

Fixed a bug where equipment tooltips could extend beyond the screen boundaries.

Addressed multiple resolution-related issues, including:
　- Mouse cursor offset
　- Incorrect maximum resolution detection caused by screen scaling

Fixed various issues related to UI text, occasional crashes, and interface interactions to enhance overall stability and user experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We remain committed to improving the game and delivering the best possible experience.
